discovery.mapping_cardinality: exactly one installed launcher per declared entry point
discovery.source_of_truth: each installed distribution's own declared [console_scripts] entry points, read from <dist-info>/entry_points.txt

fingerprint_exclusion: bin/** is never wholesale excluded from RuntimeFingerprintV3; only the declared console-script launcher rows move from raw semantic RECORD content into ConsoleScriptSemanticV1, retaining raw hashes as diagnostics

normalization.preserved_bytes: all launcher bytes except the exact interpreter-location segment

recognized_templates.description: first line is '#!' followed by the resolved interpreter path
#!/bin/sh trampoline embedding the resolved interpreter path once, in single quotes, on the second line
recognized_templates.normalized_span: the single quoted interpreter path on the second line
